blurb: Mission: Escape offers fully immersive escape room adventures in which teams solve puzzles and race against the clock. Each room presents different high-stakes challenges and hidden clues. The experience is suitable for team building, parties, and family fun. Guests can choose from a selection of themed missions and must work together to escape within the allotted time.
extraNote: All games are private, but players can be added upon arrival.
